q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
Let me reason through this carefully.

## (a) Time left until resolution

Today is 2026-08-20. NVIDIA is scheduled to release Q2 FY2027 earnings on August 26, 2026, at which point they will provide forward guidance for Q3 FY2027. This means resolution occurs in approximately **6 days**.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The question asks for NVIDIA's **forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release** — which means the guidance they provide for **Q3 FY2027** revenue (the quarter following Q2).

From the research:
- **Consensus analyst estimate for Q3 FY2027: $103.1 billion**
- BofA Securities projects Q3 guidance could be $107-108 billion
- The range provided (99.5 to 115.5 billion) brackets these expectations

NVIDIA's recent pattern shows they tend to guide conservatively relative to analyst consensus but still bullishly. Given the Q2 FY2027 guidance came in at $91.0B (midpoint) with analyst consensus at $91.85B, NVIDIA is slightly below consensus but very close. 

For Q3, I would expect NVIDIA to guide in the ballpark of consensus or slightly below, following their typical pattern. The $103.1B analyst consensus represents solid sequential growth from Q2's projected ~$91B result (12.3% growth), which seems reasonable given AI/datacenter momentum.

**Most likely range: $102-105 billion**, with the central tendency around **$103-104 billion**.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- Deteriorating demand signals or datacenter slowdown
- New geopolitical restrictions on China sales (affecting the guidance assumptions)
- Macro economic weakness
- Supply chain disruptions
- Loss of share to competitors
- Conservative guidance to avoid missing (though NVIDIA has been fairly accurate recently)

Given NVIDIA's strong position and lack of mention of negative catalysts in the research, downside risk seems limited to the $99.5-102B range.

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Stronger-than-expected AI/datacenter demand continuing to accelerate
- Better-than-expected ASP trends
- Cloud customers pulling forward orders
- New product cycles (Blackwell ramps faster than expected)
- BofA's $107-108B scenario plays out
- NVIDIA guides aggressively given confidence in demand

Upside scenarios could take guidance toward $105-108B range.

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The research provides:
- **Q2 FY2027 guidance**: $91.0B ± 2% (issued May 20, 2026)
- **Q3 FY2027 consensus**: $103.1B (as of August 12, 2026)
- **BofA higher estimate for Q3**: $107-108B

This directly addresses the forward guidance expected. The consensus $103.1B and BofA's more bullish $107-108B provide direct benchmarks for what guidance might be.

---

## Analysis

The question specifically asks for the forward guidance NVIDIA will provide on August 26, 2026. That guidance will be for Q3 FY2027 revenue.

Key facts:
1. Analyst consensus is $103.1B for Q3 FY2027
2. Some analysts (BofA) project $107-108B
3. NVIDIA typically guides near or slightly below consensus
4. The company has momentum and no negative catalysts mentioned
5. With only 6 days to resolution, this is essentially determined—the company has likely finalized guidance

Given NVIDIA's recent conservative-but-confident guidance pattern, and that consensus at $103.1B seems well-researched across 40 analysts, I expect guidance to land near $103-104B with some probability of upside toward $105-107B if they're feeling particularly bullish.

The distribution should be:
- Heavy probability mass: $102-105B
- Upside tail: $105-109B  
- Downside tail: $99-102B

**Median expectation**: $103.5 billion (very close to consensus, slight upside bias)
**10th percentile**: $100.5 billion (modest miss to consensus)
**90th percentile**: $107.5 billion (bullish guidance like BofA)

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA is scheduled to release its Q2 FY2027 earnings on August 26, 2026, and will provide forward guidance for Q3 FY2027 revenue at that time [techbloat.com](https://www.techbloat.com/nvidia-earnings-preview-another-revenue-record-is-in-sight-but-profit-growth-could-slow.html). For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA's own guidance, issued on May 20, 2026, anticipates revenue of $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%, excluding any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). This guidance represents a base case of another quarterly revenue record [techbloat.com](https://www.techbloat.com/nvidia-earnings-preview-another-revenue-record-is-in-sight-but-profit-growth-could-slow.html).

Consensus estimates from 40 analysts, updated on August 12, 2026, project Q2 FY2027 revenue at $91.85 billion, approximately 0.9% above NVIDIA's midpoint guidance [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/). For Q3 FY2027, consensus revenue is $103.1 billion [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/), [techbloat.com](https://www.techbloat.com/nvidia-earnings-preview-another-revenue-record-is-in-sight-but-profit-growth-could-slow.html). Some estimates, like BofA Securities' August 10 preview, project an even higher Q3 FY2027 outlook of approximately $107 billion to $108 billion [techbloat.com](https://www.techbloat.com/nvidia-earnings-preview-another-revenue-record-is-in-sight-but-profit-growth-could-slow.html). The Q3 guide's assumption regarding China Data Center revenue will be a key detail to watch [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/).
